onThisDay: 1945 - US soldiers raised the flag on Iwo Jima in one of the most iconic photographs ever taken

1868 - W.E.B. Du Bois was born — he became one of the most influential civil rights leaders in history

newsHeadlines.headline: Team USA win first men's ice hockey gold since 1980 at Winter Olympics
newsHeadlines.summary: The US men's hockey team beat Canada in overtime at the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Games — their first Olympic gold in 46 years

newsHeadlines.headline: Young innovators from 47 countries compete to solve real-world problems
newsHeadlines.summary: Nearly 4,000 young people created solutions for issues like financial literacy and AI-powered health tools in a global competition

newsHeadlines.headline: California grants new protections to endangered mountain lions
newsHeadlines.summary: Wildlife officials approved new laws to protect coastal mountain lions facing extinction due to habitat loss and road accidents
